anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the anodes of D4, D14, and D23. It is not connected to +3V3, to the switched LED rail /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV, or to any driver.
anomalies.expected: A net named /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW is an LED anode power rail and should be connected to a 3.3 V supply or to a buffer/switch that can drive it, so the LEDs can conduct.
anomalies.impact: The Ethernet link/activity LEDs (D14/D23) and the Pi activity LED (D4) have no anode supply and will remain off.

anomalies.observed: D30 pin 4 (A2) and R60 pin 2 are both on ESTOP_OUT, while D30 pin 2 (K2) and R60 pin 1 form Net-(D30-K2). The LED and resistor are connected in a closed loop with no other reference node.
anomalies.expected: A status LED should be connected between ESTOP_OUT and a fixed rail (for example anode to /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV and cathode through R60 to ESTOP_OUT, or cathode to GND) so current can flow when ESTOP_OUT changes.
anomalies.impact: The second half of the dual LED D30 cannot light, removing the intended visual indication for ESTOP_OUT/e-stop status.
